extraction_note: Bot project (domain/nlu/rules/actions) is checked out at multiagent-testbed/benchmark-apps/rasa/ but the Rasa framework itself runs from the rasa/rasa:latest image. Extracted rasa/server.py (the actual REST API + auth implementation) via `docker create` + `docker cp` (no container run) to verify auth behavior from source rather than the absence of a CLI flag alone.
notes: SOURCE-VERIFIED, UNAUTHENTICATED-BY-DEFAULT FINDING: rasa/server.py's requires_auth() decorator (applied to nearly every route, e.g. lines 703,802,829,917,975,995,1045 etc. before @app.post/@app.get) checks, at line 261: `elif token is None and app.config.get('USE_JWT') is None: # authentication is disabled` — i.e. if no auth_token was passed to create_app() AND no JWT config is set, the check is bypassed entirely. This container's docker-compose.yml command is `run --enable-api --cors "*" -p 5005` with no `--auth-token` or `--jwt-secret` flag, so auth_token=None and USE_JWT is unset — every requires_auth-wrapped route (including /model/parse, /model/predict, /conversations/<id>/messages, /conversations/<id>/execute) is reachable with zero authentication in this deployment. /model/parse (server.py:1295) runs raw text through the trained NLU pipeline and returns extracted intent/entities — the clearest 'send text, get AI inference back' endpoint. /conversations/<conversation_id>/messages (server.py:994) appends a user message to a tracker, which can trigger the dialogue policy/action prediction. chat_ui_present is false: no frontend/web UI source exists in this checkout at all (headless bot-config project, credentials.yml only configures the 'rest' channel, no widget files found) — the public-facing conversational entry point would be a channel webhook (commonly /webhooks/rest/webhook in Rasa) registered via channel-plugin code that is NOT part of server.py and was not extracted/verified here, so it is deliberately excluded from ai_endpoints_true rather than assumed from general Rasa knowledge. This is a source-verified server-API finding, not a channel-webhook finding.
